features.note: Voxel chunkiness is gone: the drive blade is a smooth curved vane presenting its bright face while top and bottom blades tilt the opposite way (dark underside above, lit strip below) — counter-rotation at ~30% reads and matches the HUD. But at structural granularity the blade reads as a THIN single-curved sheet: no lens-shaped double-skin airfoil section is visible at the blade ends or along the lower edge, so the 'airfoil blades' half of the feature cannot be confirmed from these pixels.

Plated cylindrical stub clearly protrudes from the frame right face with a visibly free spindle length (reads ~40-50 mm at scale) before the dark clamp bracket; the beveled orange body hangs offset on the shaft, never flush on the frame, with two small bolt heads at the clamp. A dark strap plate descends from the actuator underside toward the frame right flange near a fastener — present and separate from the cable, though its slot does not read and the contact patch is only just legible, which caps the score at threshold.

Crisp light disc with a distinct dark pointer sits on the actuator head on the shaft axis — correct location and now a real cylindrical form, not a voxel stack. Printed 0-90 arc is absent but deferred to the materials pass (not penalized); 1:1 rotation is unverifiable from a still.

Channel frame reads with real ~0.13 m depth against the 0.60 m face, flange rings on BOTH faces (front flange with a ring of discrete fastener heads, rear flange edge visible along the top-back), and visible wall thickness at the interior top opening. Proportions match 600x400x127.

The non-actuator (left) side still shows only a flat dark vertical slab, proud of the left flange and spanning roughly the upper third of the face — the blockout's carried correction (articulated cranks + tie rod) is NOT delivered: no discrete crank arms, no cylindrical tie rod, no pin heads, and no axle ends read at the three blade heights. At this grazing angle a correctly articulated linkage should still silhouette; a slab is what the pixels show.

important_features.note: Blade edge seals barely read — the dark line along the drive blade's lower edge is ambiguous with shadow, and jamb seals at the frame interior sides are indistinguishable from the dark interior. Regressed in legibility versus the blockout capture.
Clean light rectangular label plate reads on the orange body's front face at plausible label proportions; printed text is a materials-pass item.

A thin dark curve exits below the actuator and droops — reads as a catenary tube, not a straight rod — but most of its run is occluded by the CONTROL DE EQUIPO panel, so only the first bend is verifiable.

defects: Left-side linkage is a single flat dark slab spanning only the upper portion of the left face: no discrete cranks, no cylindrical tie rod, no visible pins — the blockout carry-forward correction was not applied.
Drive blade reads as a thin single-curved sheet; no double-skin airfoil section thickness is visible at blade ends or along the exposed long edge.
Anti-rotation strap's slot does not read and its landing on the frame right face is only marginally legible.
EPDM blade-edge and jamb seals barely read — dark lines are ambiguous with shadow at this angle.
Cable catenary is mostly hidden behind the bottom-right UI panel, leaving only the first bend as evidence.
corrections: Rebuild side_linkage as discrete geometry: three short crank arms at the left blade-axle ends, one cylindrical tie rod spanning all three axle heights (0.133 pitch), and visible pin cylinders at each crank/rod joint; offset the assembly from the left face enough that cranks and pins silhouette at the spec camera (azimuth 42).
Give each blade a lens-shaped double-skin airfoil section: visible center thickness tapering toward both long edges, so the section profile reads at the blade ends and along the lit lower edge.
Make the anti-rotation strap read: cut the visible slot into the strap plate and land its foot flat on the frame right face with a fastener head at the contact patch.
Thicken the black EPDM seal strips on the blade long edges and add legible jamb seal strips on the frame interior side faces so they read as parts, not shadow.
Route the cable droop (or nudge its exit direction) so the catenary clears the bottom-right UI panel and is verifiable in the capture.
